subject: Application: Backend Engineer (Go) – ref. BE-2026-04
body: Your platform team's focus on developer tooling is what drew me to this Backend Engineer role: building reliable Go services on PostgreSQL is exactly what I have been doing for the past two years.

As the sole developer for a non-profit's web presence, I designed and built a bilingual website with an admin dashboard and CMS in Go and PostgreSQL, and introduced CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker Compose deployments.
Before that, I delivered React and Next.js applications for clients and maintained their servers. I enjoy owning features end to end and explaining technical trade-offs clearly.
I can start immediately, full-time (40 hours per week), and would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
